reviews.reason: Ceremony is the stated subject, so a useful contrast is not automatically a contradiction. Qualify the Good/Bad branch to retain examples that convey a necessary distinction.
The universal in-place update rule omits immutable event evidence. Separate one authoritative current-state view from distinct historical observations and approvals.
Session gates and routing moved into technique Protocol violate the owning activity boundary. Presentation should be performed by the activity; the technique emits its declared evidence.
A line budget cannot establish fact ownership or semantic validity. Apply evidence-specific checks, and make an unresolved required invariant block completion.

Audience alone does not determine a required serialization. This suggested policy repair also needs coordinated updates to check-audience and any corresponding schema/consumer tests; changing prose alone would be insufficient.
The artifact-link requirement does not justify changing every consumer-required filename to a numeric-prefix form.
The witness is conditional on the actual presentation channel. Verify rendered notice before removing prose; no missing notice in the current client is asserted by this static review.

The current-session distinction can already cover an authoring run. Explicitly allow applying a cited authoring contract while continuing to forbid copied global criteria; do not classify all authoring obligations as misplaced.

The copied-criteria cases overlap. Thin scoped walkers are already explicitly exempted, so independent review is not inherently prohibited; clarify that exception and consolidate the duplicate criterion.
The one-write exception already excludes the directory/write witness. Clarify its precedence over order-sensitivity; do not claim the full rule necessarily demands micro-phases.
Potential future consumption is too broad to distinguish a local intermediate from a public output. Name the actual promised product or consumer before requiring a declaration.

An almost-fitting shared contract must satisfy the missing guarantee before the local implementation is deleted. The existing exception permits such owner changes but the prescribed repair omits that step.
